title: Welcoming Ajay Mittal, our First Chief Business Officer
summary: Ajay will shape how we introduce new ways to care for our customers and partner closely with our leadership team as we enter our next phase of growth.
body_markdown:
Nearly three million customers rely on Hims & Hers, and more of them are coming to the platform for help across multiple conditions. We’re no longer helping people manage a single condition with a simple solution. We’ve become a destination for building everyday health, helping people discover what next steps are best for their unique journey.


Because of that growth and breadth, we’re creating a new leadership role at Hims & Hers: Ajay Mittal is joining as our first-ever Chief Business Officer, bringing nearly two decades of strategic operations experience to our executive team. This is a natural next step for the company we’ve become and where we’re heading as we integrate more services into a unified Hims & Hers customer experience.


In this role, Ajay will oversee strategy and growth for our US business. He’ll work closely with leaders across the company to shape how we introduce new ways to provide for our customers, making how we show up for them more personal, more accessible, and more integrated. His focus will be on turning our growing capabilities into offerings that make Hims & Hers an increasingly valuable part of our customers' everyday lives.


Ajay has spent his career scaling transformative experiences for millions of people, and building the teams behind them. After starting his career in management consulting at Deloitte, he went on to spend more than six years at DoorDash, where he led strategy and operations during a period of explosive growth, including the company’s IPO. Most recently, he was COO at Rappi, an on-demand delivery platform in Latin America, where he spent nearly five years expanding the platform’s reach to more households across the region.


We believe great healthcare should be available in a single, simple, and personal platform – just like all the world-class consumer experiences people already trust. Adding Ajay to our team brings us closer to that reality for people everywhere.
